title: Import media files stored flat, not in prefix subdirs
description: import.rs:391-393. Imported media files are stored as media_dir/media_id.ext (line 393: format\!("{media_id}.{ext}")) without the hex-prefix subdirectory that upload uses (media.rs:221: format\!("media/{prefix}/{id}.{ext}")). This means imported media URLs will not match the path structure that the media serving route expects. The DB row stores dest_filename (just the filename, no path prefix) at line 427, while upload stores the full relative path 'media/{prefix}/{id}.{ext}'. Imported media will likely 404 when accessed via the API.
